title: Anxiety & Peace
description: Scriptures to quiet an anxious mind and return your attention to the peace and nearness of God.

title: Sleep & Rest
description: A gentle sequence for releasing the day, receiving God's care, and settling into restorative rest.

title: Healing
description: Passages of comfort and prayer for those seeking God's presence through sickness, pain, or recovery.

title: Strength in Hard Times
description: Scriptures for courage, endurance, and the assurance that weakness is not the end of your story.

title: Faith
description: A focused collection for trusting God's character, promises, and direction when the path is not yet visible.

title: Hope
description: Words to lift your perspective toward God's faithfulness, mercy, and the future he is still shaping.

title: Protection
description: Scriptures declaring God's shelter, watchful care, and steady presence in moments of fear or uncertainty.

title: Gratitude
description: A joyful sequence for remembering God's goodness and practicing thanksgiving in every season.
